verdict.rationale: Eqvista is an equity-management SaaS, and such a platform could plausibly offer background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence covers cap table management, vesting schedules, e-signing, valuations and reports. None of it documents user-configurable automations, triggers, scheduled jobs or autonomous agents that run in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
